recognition.prompt: Scratch the back of your head.
Rest a hand on top of your head.
Put both hands on your hips.
Give a thumbs-up during a conversation.
Rub your chin as though thinking.

murders.title: Removable sticker
murders.instruction: Place a small removable sticker on your chosen person’s clothing.

murders.title: Hold an object
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to hold an object for you.

murders.title: Lend an object
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to lend you an ordinary object.

murders.title: Help carry something
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to help you carry something.

murders.title: Pick up an object
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to pick up an object you have dropped.

murders.title: Put something in the bin
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to put something in the bin.

murders.title: Open a door
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to open a door for you.

murders.title: Switch a light
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to switch a light on or off.

murders.title: Another room
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to walk into another room with you.

murders.title: Write a word or number
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to write down a word or number for you.

murders.title: Fold some paper
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to fold a piece of paper.

murders.title: Read aloud
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to read something aloud.

murders.title: Tell a joke
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to tell you a joke.

murders.title: Sing a few words
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to sing a few words of a song.

murders.title: Say thank you
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to say “thank you” to you.

murders.title: Answer with a number
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to answer a question with a number.

murders.title: Finish a phrase
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to finish a familiar phrase you start.

murders.title: Wave back
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to wave back at you.

murders.title: Clap their hands
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to clap their hands.

murders.title: Copy a gesture
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to copy a gesture you make.

murders.title: Change the volume
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to turn the volume up or down.

murders.title: Explain how
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to explain how to do something.

murders.title: Say I don’t know
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to say “I don’t know”.
